phase.name: phase_1_chat_parity
phase.reason: Phase-1 aggregate checker-v2 proof is still unmaterialized and the required o_novelty_comparator remains physically unavailable. Revision21 fixes a transversal execution-starvation method defect but does not itself prove any acceptance cell or alter the required 14-role denominator.

postfreeze_unrelated_head_churn_starvati.observation: Multiple Phase-1 workers terminated or checkpointed semantic work after a SHA-only note-main advance even when the advance was caused by concurrent role-local/receipt writes rather than an authoritative control change. Evaluation is a direct witness: control20/config6 stopped before checker-v2 authoring/execution on post-freeze main drift.
postfreeze_unrelated_head_churn_starvati.exact_identity_check: For evaluation's frozen main cea125f92a56f02b0ba5a4ad0fc5e84a3108b695 and later observed main 1e7d97f3dbc84df67a2c6e876deeacb776979c4c, DESIRED_STATE remained blob d686fb31eb05333bef7853e79c26c3875c937b4c and evaluation role config remained the same blob. The stop therefore came from unrelated repository-head movement rather than a relevant control identity change.
postfreeze_unrelated_head_churn_starvati.impact: In a repository where many scheduled workers persist independent checkpoints and receipts, treating every post-freeze main SHA advance as semantic invalidation creates a positive-feedback livelock: workers cause one another to stop, reducing useful-output rate and delaying checker-v2/root evidence.

human_request_monitor.observation: Latest durable monitor receipt reports O main and canonical request queue unchanged with no new, materially changed, or reopened request.

changes_this_run.reason: Make post-semantic-freeze freshness depend on exact identity of already-approved authoritative control/config blobs, not unrelated main-SHA churn, while still forbidding newer-head semantic reads and failing closed on a real or unverifiable authoritative identity change.

before_after_rationale.before: Any observed post-freeze main SHA movement was commonly interpreted as a hard semantic stop, even when the role's frozen root/config blobs were byte-identical at the later head.
before_after_rationale.after: The startup H1/H2 bootstrap remains strict. After semantic freeze, later-head visibility may only verify exact identity of the already-approved authoritative root/config blobs. Unrelated main movement alone does not stop work; any changed or unverifiable relevant blob, or own-state/input CAS conflict, still checkpoints and defers newer semantics.
before_after_rationale.why_this_reduces_time_to_root: It removes a transversal concurrency bottleneck affecting many roles without changing substantive assignments or invalidating the checker-v2 acceptance contract, allowing long enough uninterrupted role-local work to materialize the pending checker and evidence.

method_plan.selected_plan: Identity-based post-freeze fence over each role's repository-approved authoritative control/config set, with no new-head semantic consumption.
rejected_alternatives: leave SHA-wide stop unchanged and accept repeated starvation
let workers adopt newer control mid-run
change every role config individually and stale more evidence
change O_CHAT_PARALLEL control6 or DOWNSTREAM_STATE control29 despite no substantive assignment change

contamination_audit.action_required_reason: The required novelty comparator is still physically disabled; only explicit user authorization or user action can change platform scheduler state.

rollback.condition: If any revision21 worker consumes newer-head semantic content mid-invocation, misses a real authoritative root/role/downstream config change, crosses the CLEAN boundary, or continues after authoritative identity cannot be verified, increment control again and restore revision20's stricter post-freeze stop semantics. Never mutate history or weaken authority, CLEAN, duplicate/conflict, or scheduler boundaries.

termination.reason: The transversal starvation defect is repaired in repository control, but Phase-1 proof and one physical role remain unresolved.

exact_next_action: Validate the first revision21 evaluation run: after unrelated main drift with unchanged authoritative root/config identities it must continue under its frozen tuple, never consume newer-head semantics, durably precommit checker-v2 before first execution, and run the duplicate negative, low-usefulness negative, and matched positive controls.

Validate revision21 downstream roles similarly using their full already-approved authoritative set, including DOWNSTREAM_STATE where applicable; a genuine relevant control/config identity change must still fail closed.
Require evidence_comparator config13 independent recomputation after checker-v2 artifacts exist.
Re-observe o_novelty_comparator physical availability; keep the required 14-role denominator and do not mutate platform schedule without explicit user authorization.
Do not enter Phase 2 until physical pool integrity, all required role cells, and aggregate hard gates are durably proven.
